sources.title: Mammoth-1 and Elephant-1: frontier decision models | Base Labs
sources.snippet: It beats models such as Microsoft-Decision-1, Perplexity Decider v1.1 27B and Jev. Comparative performance of mammoth-1 and elephant-1 on the Jev Decision Index and our replication of the Artificial Analysis Decision Index. mammoth-1 leads the Jev Decision Index at 71.24; elephant-1 is the top 9B model.
